notes: HTTP-first access (curl + browser UA) worked throughout, no browser automation needed. robots.txt names ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai etc. with Disallow: /c/*, /products/*, /collections/*, /api/*, /all-products, /customer*, /sso/* (same disallow list applies to User-agent: * and Googlebot) -- this is a general crawl-policy for campaign/PDP/API paths, not a Claude-specific 'Disallow: /' site block, so it does not trigger policy_opt_out; none of the extracted category URLs fall under a disallowed path (they are top-level slugs, not /c/* or /products/*). Discovery: sitemap.xml -> sitemap-categories.xml + sitemap-filtered-categories.xml (93k/1.6MB, full regex scan for natale/avvento/addobb, back-to-school, black/friday, halloween, pasqua, san-valentino, capodanno, diwali, epifania, carnevale, befana -- only Christmas ('natale'/'natalizi'/'avvento') and 'back-to-school' hit; no Halloween/Easter/Valentine/New Year/Diwali/Black Friday category exists on this storefront). Cross-linked each Christmas PLP's outbound hrefs to reconstruct the real hierarchy: natale/ (root, own 137-product listing) links to natale-oggetti-decorativi, alberi-natale, decorazioni-albero-natale, decorazioni-tavola-natale, cuscini-decorativi-natale, candele-portacandele-natalizi, decorazioni-natalizie, tessili-natalizi; decorazioni-albero-natale/alberi-natale in turn link to illuminazione-natale, palline-di-natale, natale-puntali-albero; decorazioni-tavola-natale links to servizio-piatti-natale, tovaglie-natalizie; tessili-natalizi links to coperte-natalizie, copripiumini-natalizi; natale-oggetti-decorativi links to decorazioni-avvento. Every node in this tree carries its own real product count (none are pure name-only grouping nodes), so all are emitted as leaf rows (is_group:false) rather than a synthetic parent; natale/ is kept as its own row since it is a genuine curated PLP with 137 products, not just navigation. qty taken from the rendered 'Visualizzazione di X su Y prodotti' pagination footer (site's own displayed total) on each PLP. Dropped per the shared core's 0-qty rule (found, verified genuinely 0 products via the page's own '0 Prodotti' filter-bar counter, not a fetch failure -- likely off-season/pre-stock in September for tree-and-lighting items): illuminazione-natale (Christmas Lighting), alberi-natale (Christmas Trees), decorazioni-albero-natale (Christmas Tree Decorations), palline-di-natale (Christmas Baubles), natale-puntali-albero (Christmas Tree Toppers), temi-stili-natalizi (Christmas Themes & Styles), ghirlande-e-corone (Christmas Wreaths), advent-wreaths (Advent Wreaths). cuscini-estivi-2/ is a duplicate of cuscini-estivi/ (identical title 'Cuscini estivi, decorativi e per divano' and identical count 120 su 290) -- kept cuscini-estivi/ only, per overlap rule. Boundary case flagged per the brief's explicit warning (same pattern as Westwing UK's Fall/Spring/Summer Cushions): cuscini-primaverili/estivi/autunnali are a generic 'cushions' product type merely tagged with a loose seasonal/style adjective (spring/summer/autumn), not tied to any named holiday or festival in the site's own taxonomy -- included but flagged MANUAL REVIEW rather than silently included or excluded. candele-led/ (LED candles, 21 products) was checked and excluded -- no seasonal association, plain product-type category.
